last_result.reason: Crowd anomaly scoring now uses per-zone density (people per megapixel of the bound zone footprint) and one-sided motion baselines instead of raw person count, with the engine binding the resolved zone via a new optional bind_zone() hook and 5 new regression tests; all gates pass and accuracy was not measured because model weights and labelled clips are missing.

current.goal: Reduce weapon false positives with temporal voting, person-weapon association, and hard negatives such as phones, tools, and holsters.
